verdict: Ads have been dark 19 days; five overdue items need resolution now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns delivered 8 leads at $26.71 each on $213.66 in total spend — but all of that activity came before September 15, and ads have been off for the past 19 days with zero leads generated since September 11. Separately, your Google Business Profile engagement dropped 43% week-over-week, with the last three days showing no actions at all, confirming the decline is real and accelerating. On the lead-management side, 17 opportunities are recorded in your CRM from 270 contacts, but none have converted to confirmed appointments — that gap points to how incoming inquiries are being handled, not the ads themselves. Five agreed milestones — including attribution setup, contact cleanup, dashboard delivery, and your renewal decision — remain open, and getting those resolved is the immediate priority so you have a clear picture before your engagement ends October 31. Ads will be back on once those items are addressed, and conversion tracking is being repaired so your website results stop showing as zero.
